lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Densely packed clusters immediately posterior to the branchial region, transitioning into organized vertical columns of high-luminance spots across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating a distinct grid-like matrix of anchor nodes along the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges extending from the mid-body toward the posterior, characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal edge and shadows on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 5-7 high-intensity circular pixel clusters localized within the anterior-medial region of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two elongated, dark silhouettes (commensal organisms) positioned ventrally to the pectoral fin insertion point.
